name: Cross Cultural Ministry
overview: Scripture commands believers to actively engage in cross cultural ministry by making disciples of all nations and preaching the gospel to every creature, as emphasized in Matthew 28:19 and Mark 16:15. This mission is empowered by the Holy Spirit to witness broadly—from local regions to the ends of the earth (Acts 1:8). God's love for the world is demonstrated through the gift of His Son, offering eternal life to all who believe (John 3:16), while the natural world reveals His invisible attributes, holding all accountable to Him (Romans 1:20). The apostolic calling, exemplified by Paul, underscores a life set apart to proclaim this gospel universally (Romans 1:1).
